sections.title: Bone Bottom to Deep Docks
sections.summary: Keep Hunter, pick up Straight Pin, and clear Lace 1 before the Far Fields loop.

guide: Follow the Moss Grotto and Mosshome path to Silkspear.
Keep the starting Hunter Crest for this route.
stops.title: Silkspear
stops.tip: Take the Moss Grotto and Mosshome path to Silkspear. Keep the starting Hunter Crest.

guide: Defeat Bell Beast and ring the Marrow bell.
Pick up Straight Pin above Grindle’s cell on the way into Deep Docks.
Continue through Deep Docks and collect Swift Step. Loddie’s target practice comes on the return after Widow.
stops.title: Swift Step
stops.tip: Defeat Bell Beast and ring the Marrow bell. Take Straight Pin above Grindle's cell on the way to Deep Docks. Return for Loddie's challenge after Widow.

guide: Defeat Lace 1, ring the Deep Docks bell, and open its Bellway for 40 rosaries.
Take the Bone Bottom loop. Collect the free Wormways mask shard and buy Pebb’s mask shard for 300 rosaries.
Collect the Bone Bottom spool: go through the trapdoor, use the lift lever, and cross the trapped passage above town. This is the first half of pair A.
Return to Deep Docks and continue into Far Fields.
stops.title: Lace 1 defeated
stops.tip: Ring the Deep Docks bell and open its Bellway. On the Bone Bottom loop, take the free Wormways mask shard and Pebb's shard for 300. Return to Deep Docks for Far Fields. On the Bone Bottom loop, collect spool 478080 through the trapdoor and trapped lift passage; this is the first half of the Bone Bottom + Atla pair.

sections.title: Far Fields & first Greymoor pass
sections.summary: Get the Far Fields mask shard on the first pass. Buy Weighted Belt and the pouch from Mort.

guide: Take the Seamstress’s spine quest, collect the spines, and return for Drifter’s Cloak.
With the cloak, take the mask shard above the Seamstress before leaving Far Fields.
Continue past Fourth Chorus toward Pilgrim’s Rest and Greymoor.
stops.title: Drifter's Cloak
stops.tip: Gather spines for the Seamstress. Take the mask shard above her with the cloak before leaving the area. Continue past Fourth Chorus.

guide: On the first Pilgrim’s Rest visit, buy Weighted Belt for 160 rosaries and the Tool Pouch for 220.
Pay the 30-rosary entry only if the door gear is still intact. Break the gear from inside.
Reach Halfway Home and open Greymoor Bellway for 60 rosaries.
Exhaust Garmond and Zaza’s first conversation before going to Moorwing.
stops.title: Halfway Home
stops.tip: Budget 380 rosaries for Mort's Weighted Belt (160) and Tool Pouch (220), plus 30 for entry if the door gear is intact. Break the gear from inside. Open Greymoor Bellway for 60 and exhaust the first Garmond conversation before Moorwing.

purchases.conditional: if the door gear is intact

stops.shoppingNote: 440 rosaries for Belt, pouch, and Greymoor travel; 470 if the entry gear is intact. Loddie's necklace comes after Widow.

guide: Take the route west from Halfway Home toward Moorwing.
Defeat Moorwing, then continue toward Bellhart and Shellwood.
Take useful lockets along the path. The locket on the Halfway Home ledge needs double-jump, so leave it.
stops.title: Moorwing defeated
stops.tip: Take the Halfway Home route west to Moorwing, then continue toward Shellwood. Keep locket pickups on the no-double-jump path; the Halfway Home ledge locket requires Faydown Cloak and is skipped.

sections.title: Cling Grip to Last Judge
sections.summary: Upgrade Hunter and Needle, finish two spool pairs, and enter Act 2 through Blasted Steps.

guide: Take the Shellwood mask-shard branch before continuing upward.
Fight Sister Splinter and collect Cling Grip.
Open the Shellwood shortcut toward Blasted Steps, then continue toward upper Bellhart and Widow.
stops.title: Cling Grip
stops.tip: Take the Shellwood mask-shard branch and fight Sister Splinter on the way to Cling Grip. Open the Shellwood shortcut toward Blasted Steps.

guide: Enter upper Bellhart and drop down-left.
Break the wall to open the shorter Widow runback.
Rest at the bench before the fight.
stops.title: Widow bench
stops.tip: Enter upper Bellhart, drop down-left, and break the wall for the shorter Widow runback. Rest at the bench.

guide: Defeat Widow, collect Needolin, and ring the Bellhart bell.
Return to Bellhart for the free first Needle upgrade.
Open Bellhart Bellway for 60 rosaries. The next loop takes you to Eva, Atla, Loddie, and Forge Daughter.
stops.title: Widow / Needolin
stops.tip: Defeat Widow, obtain Needolin, ring the Bellhart bell, and get the free first Needle upgrade. Open Bellhart Bellway for the later shopping and upgrade returns. Skip Crawbug Clearing; buy the second Crafting Kit from Twelfth Architect after Clawline.

guide: Use Needolin to enter Weavenest Atla and visit Eva for Hunter’s first evolution.
Collect the Atla mask shard.
For the spool, use Cling Grip to reach the upper passage above the breakable wall and pass the Marrowmaws.
Collect the Atla fragment to complete pair A with Bone Bottom: +1 Silk capacity.
stops.title: Weavenest Atla / Eva
stops.tip: Use Needolin to enter Atla, visit Eva for Hunter's first evolution, and take the mask shard. For the planned spool, climb with Cling Grip into the upper passage above the breakable wall and pass the Marrowmaws. No double-jump or Moss Mothers fight is needed for this spool. This completes the first spool with Bone Bottom.

guide: On the post-Widow return through the Marrow, complete both Loddie rounds for the pouch and rosary necklace.
Climb through the upper Marrow with Cling Grip to reach the Deep Docks shard arena. Clear it and collect the mask shard.
At Forge Daughter, buy the first Crafting Kit for 180 rosaries and Magma Bell for 110 plus one Craftmetal. Keep another Craftmetal for Cogfly later.
For the Deep Docks spool, go southwest of the shop, cross the burning-floor room, hit the far lever, and return across the platforms. This starts pair B.
stops.mapNote: This is the first-pass Deep Docks map. The return map for the shard and Forge Daughter is missing; follow the directions and pins below.
stops.title: Forge Daughter bench
stops.tip: On the post-Widow loop, complete both Loddie rounds in the Marrow for the pouch and necklace. Collect the Cling Grip mask shard in Deep Docks. Buy Magma Bell (110 + 1 Craftmetal) and the first Crafting Kit (180). The nearby rosary pickup covered the Run #2 shortfall. Collect the selected Deep Docks spool 477926 southwest of the shop: cross the burning-floor room, hit the far lever, and return across the platforms.
stops.shoppingNote: Keep one Craftmetal for Magma Bell and another for the later Cogfly. These are the planned shop costs; bench tolls are separate.

guide: Return to Bellhart after the shopping loop.
Use Greymoor Bellway to return toward Halfway Home with Cling Grip.
Continue toward the upper passage for Bell #3 and the Greymoor spool.
stops.title: Bellhart bench after shopping
stops.tip: Return to Bellhart. Use Greymoor Bellway for the Cling Grip return toward Halfway Home and Bell #3.

guide: Climb above and right of Halfway Home, take the top-right transition, and go northeast to Bell #3.
Use Cling Grip and the balloon climb to collect the upper Greymoor spool.
This completes pair B with Deep Docks: +2 total Silk capacity. The Craw Lake arena is not required for this pickup.
stops.title: Greymoor Bell #3
stops.tip: Climb above and right of Halfway Home, use the top-right transition, then go northeast to the bell. Take the Greymoor spool to complete the second spool with Deep Docks: the documented approach needs Cling Grip and a balloon climb, without double-jump or the Craw Lake arena. Skip the Ragpelt farm.

guide: Go through Shellwood and Blasted Steps to ring the fifth bell.
Open Blasted Steps Bellway for 60 rosaries; you will use it for the later Dice pickup.
Take the nearby Memory Locket and free Craftmetal before Last Judge.
Before the fight, equip Magma Bell and check that you have six masks and Needle Upgrade #1.
stops.title: Blasted Steps bench
stops.tip: Ring the fifth bell through Shellwood and Blasted Steps. Open Blasted Steps Bellway for 60 to make the later Dice pickup practical. Grab the nearby Memory Locket and free Craftmetal before Judge. Equip Magma Bell and check six masks plus Needle Upgrade #1.

stops.guideTitle: Last Judge & the Grand Gate spool
guide: With all five bells rung, play Needolin at the Grand Gate and defeat Last Judge.
Reach the Choral Chambers bench.
Use the return shortcut for the Grand Gate spool. Climb the balancing platforms, hitting their undersides to tip them into position.
Collect the fragment to start pair C, then continue toward Grand Bellway.
stops.title: Last Judge / Choral Chambers bench
stops.tip: Play Needolin at the Grand Gate after all five bells, beat Last Judge, and rest in Choral Chambers. From the Choral Chambers return shortcut, climb the Grand Gate balancing platforms for spool 478586 before continuing toward Grand Bellway. Hit the scales from underneath to tip them; no extra arena or double-jump is required.

sections.title: Songclave, lower Core & Vaults
sections.summary: Open the travel hub, clear lower Cogwork, then prepare Needle Upgrade #2.

guide: Reach Grand Bellway and open the Bell Beast for 80 rosaries.
Open its Ventrica for another 80 rosaries.
Continue toward Songclave. These two travel unlocks cost 160 in total.
stops.title: Grand Bellway bench
stops.tip: Open the Grand Bellway Bell Beast and Ventrica for 80 each. Keep the map purchase out of the travel budget.

guide: Ring the First Shrine bell in Songclave.
Open the Songclave Ventrica for 80 rosaries.
Take the White Key for the later Whiteward detour.
stops.title: Songclave bell
stops.tip: Ring the First Shrine bell, open the Songclave Ventrica, and take the White Key for Whiteward.

guide: Defeat the Cogwork Dancers.
Continue into lower Cogwork Core.
The free Magnetite Dice pickup becomes available after this fight; collect it on the planned Bellhart upgrade trip.
stops.title: Cogwork Dancers defeated
stops.tip: Beat the Dancers, then head into lower Cogwork. The free Dice pickup is available after the Dancers.

guide: Clear the lower Core route arena and collect its mask shard.
Open the top-right shortcut to upper Cogwork Core.
Continue to Whispering Vaults. Leave the optional lower Core spool branch.
stops.title: Lower Cogwork Core / bench
stops.tip: Clear the route arena, grab its mask shard, and open the top-right shortcut to upper Core. Skip the optional lower Core spool branch; the final six-fragment plan uses Grand Gate instead.

guide: Clear the Whispering Vaults arena and open the shortcut up to Songclave.
Collect the hidden Vaults mask shard and Pale Oil. This is the planned seven-mask point.
Return to Bellhart for Needle Upgrade #2: one Pale Oil, no rosary charge.
Use the Blasted Steps Bellway stop to collect the free Magnetite Dice from Lumble.
Return to Grand Bellway and continue toward Trobbio.
stops.title: Whispering Vaults arena / Songclave bench
stops.tip: Clear the Vaults arena and open the shortcut up to Songclave. Pick up the hidden mask shard and Pale Oil on the Vaults leg. Upgrade the Needle in Bellhart, then collect the free Dice from Lumble while using the Bellway before returning to Grand Bellway for Trobbio.

sections.title: Clawline, melody & roof duel
sections.summary: Take the Whiteward Injector Band detour and set up the Garmond & Zaza return through the roof gate.

guide: Defeat Trobbio and collect Claw Mirror.
Take his lift down, open the left shortcut, and send the lift back up.
Use the White Key detour through Whiteward for Injector Band.
Continue toward the Cauldron with Magma Bell ready.
stops.title: Grand Bellway bench after Trobbio
stops.tip: Defeat Trobbio for Claw Mirror. Take his lift down, open the left shortcut, and send the lift back up. Detour through Whiteward for Injector Band on the way to the Cauldron.

guide: Collect Clawline and clear the Cauldron’s normal exit arena.
Use the bench by Twelfth Architect and buy the second Crafting Kit for 450 rosaries.
For the eastern Underworks spool, descend the eastern shaft and break into the small lava room from the east.
Collect the fragment to complete pair C with Grand Gate: +3 total Silk capacity.
stops.title: Clawline / Cauldron clear
stops.tip: Keep Magma Bell for the Cauldron. Get Clawline, clear its normal exit arena, and use the bench by Twelfth Architect. Buy the second Crafting Kit for 450 rosaries. Collect the confirmed eastern Underworks spool 478704 by descending the eastern shaft and breaking the small lava room's wall from the east. This completes the third spool with Grand Gate.
stops.shoppingNote: Earn any shortfall in the Citadel before the Cauldron visit. This replaces the 25-Ragpelt farming detour.

guide: Return below Trobbio’s lift, then go right and up for Vaultkeeper’s Melody.
Complete the box and wind-current rooms toward outer Songclave.
Take the locket on the wind route.
Hit the far-left roof-gate lever. Leave through the shortcut and rest before returning for the duel.
stops.title: Vaultkeeper's Melody
stops.tip: Return below Trobbio's lift, then go right and up for the melody. Solve the box and wind-current rooms to outer Songclave. Take the wind-route locket and hit the far-left roof gate lever. Leave via the shortcut and rest before returning.

guide: Use the open roof shortcut to return to Garmond and Zaza.
Win the duel and exhaust Garmond’s dialogue afterward.
Head toward High Halls. Their help will be available at the Forum door.
stops.title: G&Z duel / Cogwork Core bench
stops.tip: Use the open roof shortcut to return for the duel. Exhaust Garmond's dialogue after winning. Head toward High Halls. The Run #2 split was the Cogwork Core bench after the win.

sections.title: High Halls & three melodies
sections.summary: Use both red tools and G&Z for the Forum. Finish the melodies and prepare for Lace.

guide: On the Clawline descent, take the left side room and spend one Craftmetal on Cogfly.
Open the High Halls Ventrica for 80 rosaries and rest at the bench.
Equip Straight Pin + Cogfly, Claw Mirror + Injector Band, and Weighted Belt + Magnetite Dice.
Before the Forum, check both pouch upgrades and both Crafting Kits: 6 Cogflies, 18 Straight Pins, and 7 Cogfly damage per hit.
stops.title: High Halls bench with Cogfly
stops.tip: Take the left side room on the Clawline descent for Cogfly (1 Craftmetal). At the bench equip Straight Pin + Cogfly and Claw Mirror + Injector Band, with Belt + Dice. Open the High Halls Ventrica for the Citadel return. Check the 2/4 pouch and damage targets before the Forum.

guide: Accept Garmond and Zaza’s help at the Forum door inside High Halls.
Use Cogflies and pins on the dangerous waves while the duo shares the pressure.
Clear the Forum and continue to Conductor’s Melody.
stops.title: High Halls Forum cleared
stops.tip: Accept G&Z's help at the Forum door inside High Halls. Use Cogflies and pins on the dangerous waves and let the duo share the pressure. Run #2 needed three attempts with their help, compared with about eight on scout.

guide: Collect Conductor’s Melody after the Forum.
Return through the Citadel toward upper Cogwork Core.
Use the upper Core shortcut opened on the earlier lower Core visit.
stops.title: Conductor's Melody
stops.tip: Collect the melody after the Forum. Return through the Citadel to upper Cogwork.

guide: Climb upper Cogwork Core to the Architect’s Melody puzzle.
From the initial state, hit the levers left to right in the first row: 1–3–3–3.
Second row: 2–0–0–3. Third row: 0–1–1–1. Fourth row: 1–1–0–2.
If a lever has already moved, check the white-line alignment rather than repeating the initial counts.
Collect Architect’s Melody and return toward the final elevator.
stops.title: Architect's Melody
stops.tip: Use the upper Core shortcut and solve the four lever rows. From the initial state, hit left-to-right in each row: 1–3–3–3, 2–0–0–3, 0–1–1–1, then 1–1–0–2. Check the white-line alignment if any lever has moved.

guide: Rest before the final approach.
Check Claw Mirror + Injector Band, Weighted Belt + Magnetite Dice, and your available Silk.
Play the Threefold Melody at the elevator and ascend to Lace 2.
stops.title: Checkpoint 1 before Lace 2
stops.tip: Rest before the final approach. Play the Threefold Melody at the elevator and ascend to Lace. Check Claw Mirror + Injector Band, Weighted Belt + Magnetite Dice, and your available Silk.

sections.title: Lace 2 & Grand Mother Silk
sections.summary: Wait for Lace's openings and reserve Silk for Bind. Log the actual finish time.

guide: Let Lace approach and punish her recovery. Patient one- or two-hit openings are enough.
Keep Silk available for Bind and heal in safe openings.
Use Straight Pin only when the opening is safe. Keep the selected Mirror, Injector Band, Belt, and Dice loadout.
After winning, continue to Terminus for the final rest.
stops.title: Lace 2 defeated
stops.tip: Let her approach and punish the recovery. Keep Silk for healing and throw a pin only when the opening is safe. Keep the selected Run #2 winning loadout: Claw Mirror + Injector Band, with Weighted Belt + Magnetite Dice. Belt was the noticeable help.

guide: Rest at the Terminus bench and open the final shortcut.
Fight Grand Mother Silk. Use Cogflies to maintain pressure when she is out of Needle range.
After finishing Act 2, record the actual final in-game time in the run log.
stops.title: Grand Mother Silk / finish
stops.tip: Rest at the Terminus bench and open the final shortcut. Use Cogflies to maintain pressure when she is out of Needle range. Record the final in-game time after finishing Act 2.

preparations.title: Silk pair A · Bone Bottom + Atla
preparations.detail: First completed spool: collect Bone Bottom on the early town loop, then Atla after Widow during the Eva visit. Traps and ordinary enemies; no added arena.

items.title: Bone Bottom
items.detail: Trapdoor, lift lever, and trapped passage above town

items.title: Weavenest Atla
items.detail: Upper branch during the Eva visit

preparations.title: Silk pair B · Deep Docks + Greymoor
preparations.detail: Second completed spool: Deep Docks during the Forge Daughter visit, then the Greymoor balloon climb on the Cling Grip return for Bell #3. No Craw Lake arena clear.

items.title: Deep Docks
items.detail: Burning-floor room and far lever southwest of Forge Daughter

preparations.title: Silk pair C · Grand Gate + Underworks
preparations.detail: Third completed spool: the Grand Gate scale-platform climb in Act 2, then the eastern Underworks breakable-wall room.

items.title: Grand Gate
items.detail: Climb the balancing platforms; strike their undersides

preparations.title: Tool Pouch · target 2/4
preparations.detail: The pair raises capacity to 6 Cogflies and 18 Straight Pins.

items.title: Mort's Tool Pouch
items.detail: 220 rosaries on the first Pilgrim's Rest pass

preparations.title: Crafting Kit · target 2/4
preparations.detail: Two damage upgrades take Cogflies to 7 damage per hit. Buy Forge Daughter's first kit, then Twelfth Architect's 450-rosary kit after Clawline.

items.title: Forge Daughter's kit
items.detail: 180 rosaries at the Deep Docks visit

items.title: Twelfth Architect's kit
items.detail: 450 rosaries after Clawline; skip the Ragpelt farm

preparations.title: Earlier pickup record
preparations.detail: Preserves previously checked pickups from earlier route versions. These are outside the current six-fragment plan.

items.title: Lower Cogwork Core
items.detail: Earlier candidate; omitted from the final six-fragment route

research.title: Lace 2 consistency
research.detail: Practice the patient approach and log retries separately from the travel detour. Test Belt plus Injector Band, reserve Silk for Bind, and record safe Straight Pin openings.

research.title: Six fragments, three complete spools
research.detail: Locked by Joseph: Bone Bottom + Atla, Deep Docks + Greymoor, and Grand Gate + eastern Underworks for +3 Silk capacity. No added spool arenas. Skip the central Underworks and lower Core alternatives; the spool decision is closed.

research.title: Buy the second Crafting Kit
research.detail: Joseph reports that earning rosaries in the Citadel is straightforward. Buy Twelfth Architect's kit for 450 after Clawline and skip Crawbug Clearing and the 25-Ragpelt farm.

research.title: Current Mirror baseline
research.detail: Mirror + Injector Band remains the current timed-route baseline with Belt and Dice. Joseph reopened Fractured Mask on November 10 and scouted the Hunter’s March approach with upgraded gear. The evidence and unresolved late-backtrack timing are in HANDOFF.md; no route or loadout change has been chosen.

research.title: Thread Storm and Craw Lake
research.detail: A documented route takes Thread Storm after Clawline and Faydown Cloak without clearing the arena. The earlier Halfway Home route is verified for Bell #3, and the late spool pickup is separate evidence. Keep Thread Storm skipped for this route.

research.title: Show upcoming purchase costs
research.detail: Checkpoint shopping reminders show the next planned spending stop, item costs, conditional tolls, and materials. Joseph is unsure the early budget will cover everything; the reminders do not assume a wallet balance. Lockets only need to fill Hunter, and both files reportedly have one spare Craftmetal.
